Emily (Support): Sam — heads up, AcmePay reports intermittent TLS handshake failures to their Redwood Private endpoint after putting traffic through their corp proxy. 502s + `handshake_failure` in our logs. Can you share their error samples?
Sam (Customer): They see `curl: (35) error:1408F10B:SSL routines:ssl3_get_record:wrong version number` from app side and our Java client logs `TLSHandshakeException: handshake_failure`. Happening sporadically across requests.
Emily (Support): Alex, any known negotiation quirks with enterprise proxies?
Alex (Eng-Infra): Not common but possible. Ask them to run `openssl s_client` with explicit TLS versions and capture the ClientHello/ServerHello. Also tcpdump of the 3-way TLS exchange would help. Proxy might be doing TLS inspection or forcing a particular cipher set.
Sam (Customer): They ran quick tests. `openssl s_client -connect api.private.redwood.acme:443 -servername api.private.redwood.acme -tls1_3` -> connection resets, "no peer certificate". Forcing `-tls1_2` succeeds. Paste of openssl output: ```CONNECTED(00000003)\n140735...:ssl3_get_record:wrong version number\n---\nNo peer certificate available\n---```
Jordan (Oncall): If TLS1.3 attempts fail but TLS1.2 succeeds, either the proxy refuses TLS1.3 or it's terminating and re-establishing with an incompatible cipher suite. Does the proxy present a corporate cert?
Sam (Customer): They confirm proxy terminates TLS (corporate CA) and rewrites SNI to an internal hostname. Vendor is BlueGate 3.2.1. Their `openssl ciphers -v` shows only RSA-based ciphers: `AES128-SHA, AES256-SHA, DES-CBC3-SHA` — no ECDHE/ECDSA.
Alex (Eng-Infra): That explains it. Our endpoints prefer ECDHE suites and TLS1.3. If the proxy only offers RSA-only TLS1.2 suites, some clients that try TLS1.3/ECDHE will fail. Also rewriting SNI can cause the cert presented to not match our expected SANs which some clients will reject.
Emily (Support): Actionable asks for the customer/proxy team?
Alex (Eng-Infra): 1) Ask proxy vendor to enable ECDHE suites (e.g., `ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256`) and TLS1.3 support or 2) configure the proxy to use TLS passthrough for calls to our private endpoint (no termination). If their policy forbids public CA certs, enabling ECDHE is still possible.
Jordan (Oncall): Meanwhile we can offer a temporary mitigation: enable TLS1.2 fallback with compatible RSA-ECDHE cipher suites on the dedicated pool for their account. Need infra approval and pool id. This keeps connections working while they update policy.
Sam (Customer): Customer prefers we enable the short-term fallback. They can't change BlueGate policy quickly. We'll provide account id and pool id in DM.
Emily (Support): Sam — please also get tcpdump of the handshake and the exact `openssl s_client -msg -connect` output so we can confirm ServerHello/cipher selection.
Sam (Customer): Uploaded tcpdump and openssl output to the ticket. Confirm BlueGate indeed rewrites SNI and terminates TLS with RSA-only cipher list.
Alex (Eng-Infra): Confirmed from their packet capture: ClientHello -> Proxy -> Proxy responds with ServerHello selecting `TLS1.2` and `RSA-AES128-SHA` then closes when client expects TLS1.3 ECDHE. We need to allow `ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256` on the pool or accept TLS1.2 handshake variants temporarily.
Jordan (Oncall): I'm opening an infra change ticket to enable TLS1.2 fallback on pool-789 (AcmePay dedicated). Change window tonight, 3 hour maintenance, rollback ready.
Emily (Support): Noted. Sam, please confirm customer accepts maintenance window and will monitor for errors post-change.
Sam (Customer): They approved the change window. After Jordan applied the patch in a test pool, their curl tests succeeded with TLS1.2 and our live calls stopped returning handshake errors.
Alex (Eng-Infra): Long term we recommend they enable ECDHE/TLS1.3 support on BlueGate. We'll send suggested cipher list and a KB entry for proxy vendors.
Emily (Support): I'll document the temporary fix and next steps in the support ticket and link the KB. Closing action items: Sam -> vendor output + ack; Jordan -> infra change; Alex -> KB draft.
deploy-bot: config-change: enabled-tls1-2-fallback on pool-789 by Jordan at 2026-03-17T02:15Z
Emily (Support): Marking as resolved for now. Reopen if the handshake failures reappear. :white_check_mark:
